findings.issue: Grep regex `WHERE[[:space:][:alnum:]_.$]*tenant_id` matches comment lines (11 and 126 in audit-grant-trail.ts) rather than the actual SQL conditions array entry `tenant_id = $2`. A regression that removes the WHERE condition from the array but leaves the comments intact would pass the static check undetected. The real protection is the DB-gated AC-2 test.
findings.suggestion: Extend the grep pattern to also match `conditions.push.*tenant_id` or `tenant_id = \\\$` to target the actual SQL binding rather than (or in addition to) comments.
